foundation.work: Watch if the child changes the tens digit only. Common error: 65 (adds 1).
Common error: reading digits the wrong way round. Ask which digit is the tens.
Look for a strategy (take 6 then 3, or count on from 9). Note if counting by ones.
Check the child adds tens to tens. Common error: 48 or 345.

core.q: What is the value of the digit 6 in 462?
core.work: Common error: answering 6. Ask what 462 is made of (4 hundreds, 6 tens, 2 ones).

core.q: 5_ + 27 = 81. What digit goes in the blank?
core.work: Look for working backwards (81 - 27 = 54). Common error: guessing 5 or 6.

core.q: There are 4 rows of stars with 5 stars in each row. How many stars?
core.work: Does the child skip count, repeat add (5+5+5+5) or know it? All fine. Common error: 9.

core.q: A machine doubles a number, then adds 3. I put in 5. What comes out?
core.work: Watch the order. Common error: 16 (adds 3 first, then doubles) or 8.

core.q: A pen costs $1.20. A ruler costs $0.85. How much for both?
core.work: Watch for dollars and cents handled separately. Common error: $1.105 or $2.5.

core.q: A pizza is cut into 4 equal parts. I eat 3 parts. What fraction of the pizza did I eat?
core.work: Common error: 3/3 or 1/4. Ask what the bottom number tells us.

stretch.q: I think of a number. I double it, then add 3, and I get 17. What was my number?
stretch.work: Does the child work backwards (17 - 3 = 14, half of 14)? Or guess and check, which is also fine.

stretch.q: I am a 2-digit number. My tens digit is 2 more than my ones digit. My digits add up to 10. Who am I?
stretch.work: Look for a systematic list of pairs that add to 10. Common error: 73 or 55 (meets only one clue).
